E33F Second Home Senior (1 Year, Altus/Onshore)

notes: Seven separate Guide leaves; E33D is NOT_FOUND, TO_VERIFY and excluded. Absence from the price list leaves is_sold null, not false.

Each path asks at most four questions, except E33F (five: activity, age, income, sponsor, months) since the 2026-10-19 age ruling. E33E has one published initial choice (5 YEAR), selected without a duration question after its three conditions. An explicitly supplied stay_months is still validated.

Questions concern legal conditions, not possession of documents. All required evidence, expertise certificates or qualifying degrees, invitations, employment agreements and 90-day commitment reports remain in the verbatim checklist.
E33/E33E initial stay uses only the code page (up to 5 years); the general official table also lists 10 years. That conflict is TO_VERIFY, not another initial choice.

Cumulative limits are 120 months from the code pages for E33/E33A/E33B/E33C/E33E; 72 months from the separately pinned code-specific supplementary_stay_evidence for E33F/E33G. Years are never converted into days.
E33F sponsor type is not stated on its captured page and remains TO_VERIFY; an organization-only sponsor rule is not copied across.

OWNER RULING 2026-10-19 (not verbatim Law): the senior age threshold for E33E and E33F is 55, per owner ruling + Pasal 173 f angka 4 (Permenkumham 11/2024). This resolves the senior_age_threshold_55_vs_60 TO_VERIFY (and E33F's minimum_age_not_stated); the Pasal 105 ayat (10) huruf d / ITAP-page 60 conflict stays recorded in the cards' notes as history. E33F now asks the same age_55 question as E33E.
The annual-income and activity answers for E33G do not replace its required foreign-company employment agreement. Freelance work without that agreement is not offered as a route.

ITAP stage by law (owner ruling 2026-10-18 segui la legge, replacing the earlier no-KITAP rule): Permenkumham 22/2023 Pasal 173 huruf f allows ITAS to ITAP for E33 (angka 1), E33A/E33B (2), E33C (3), E33E/E33F (4, 55+ per Permenkumham 11/2024); Pasal 179 ayat (1) needs 3 years of ITAS, Pasal 178 needs commitments fulfilled. E33G has no ITAP (not in Pasal 173); E33D is TO_VERIFY. Per-code finding is in the cards (itap_eligibility_as_stated_boolean) and ITAP.json. DB itap is null for all eight, as for the other E families.
All apply_channel values remain null. Offshore/onshore labels in exact commercial price keys do not establish a legal application-location rule.
Income or allowance is not narrowed to passive income. The full selling/work restriction and its exception remain verbatim in the cards.
